purpose: Two-speaker call containing a spoken SSN, a phone number and a name. Used for PII-redaction and diarization checks.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: Thank you for calling Harbor Ridge Insurance. This is Priya. How can I help you today?

segments.speaker: B
segments.text: Hi Priya. My name is Dana Whitfield. I need to update the billing address on my policy.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: I can help with that. To verify your identity, can you give me your social security number?

segments.speaker: B
segments.text: Sure. It's nine eight seven, six five, four three two one.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: Thank you. And what is the best phone number to reach you?

segments.speaker: B
segments.text: Four one five, five five five, zero one four two.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: Got it. What is the new address?

segments.speaker: B
segments.text: Twelve forty Larkspur Avenue, Sacramento, California.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: Perfect. I have updated your policy. Is there anything else?

segments.speaker: B
segments.text: No, that is everything. Thanks for your help.

ground_truth.ssn_note: 987-65-4321 is in the range the US SSA reserves for advertising (987-65-4320 to 987-65-4329); it has never been issued.
